title: Third-Level Collapse Under a Circuit Hypothesis
statement: Suppose every language in coNP has polynomial-size, fan-in-two Boolean circuit families with polynomially many witness bits, such that a string belongs to the language exactly when some assignment to those witness bits makes the corresponding circuit accept. Then every language in $\Pi_3^P$ belongs to $\Sigma_3^P$.
hypotheses_covered: Every language in coNP has the stated polynomial-size circuit and witness representation
